rule: listing_ready may be true only when every local and external gate is true
_gate_semantics: Fields in external_gates and local_gates are deployment authorization gates, not real-time fact assertions. Each gate must be explicitly set true by the operator before listing_ready can become true. public_repo_published controls whether evidence affordance links (VERIFY, INDEPENDENT-OPERATION) are mounted in the gallery UI; setting it true is an authorized deployment action independent of current repository visibility. mainnet_contract_verified requires: signed deployment record and completed E2E rehearsal; source verification on BaseScan alone does not satisfy this gate.
